summary:
Iteration 15 (Phase-1 realtime booking + psychologist mode + admin doctor CRUD) — VERIFIED end-to-end. Backend: 16/16 pytest tests PASSED in /app/backend/tests/test_phase1_realtime_booking.py against the live preview URL. Verified against MongoDB directly for audit + linkage assertions. Coverage: (1) Slot double-book prevention — same psychologist+slot → 2nd POST /api/bookings/order returns 409 (different idempotency_key). (2) Idempotency — replaying POST /api/bookings/order with the SAME idempotency_key returns the SAME booking_id. (3) Role gating — normal user token → 403 on GET /api/psy/bookings and POST /api/psy/bookings/{id}/{accept|decline|reschedule}; psychologist token (+919999900001) → 200 on GET /api/psy/bookings and GET /api/psy/me (returns Dr. Ruchi Sharma profile with slug='ruchi-sharma'). (4) Accept/decline/reschedule flow — seeded awaiting_confirmation booking directly into db.bookings + db.slot_locks (per review-request permission, since Razorpay signature cannot be produced by automation), then hit /accept, /decline, /reschedule. Confirmed booking.status transitions to accepted/declined/rescheduled, a db.notifications record is created for the user with the correct type (booking_accepted / booking_declined / booking_rescheduled), and db.notification_audit contains channel='in_app' status='success' AND channel='push' status='failure' (expected — EMERGENT_PUSH_KEY is placeholder, web preview cannot deliver push). Reschedule path additionally verified the slot_locks row moves to the new slot_id. (5) Notification inbox — GET /api/notifications returns {notifications, unread}; GET /api/notifications/unread-count returns {unread}; POST /api/notifications/read-all zeroes the unread counter for the demo user. (6) Admin psychologist CRUD — POST /api/admin/auth {passcode:'Kanha@1983'} yields admin_token; POST /api/admin/psychologists (with token) creates a doctor (name 'TEST Dr QA Bot', login_phone '+919888800077') which appears in public GET /api/psychologists (auth'd), and a users doc is created with role='psychologist' + psychologist_id linked; DELETE /api/admin/psychologists/{pid} removes the doctor from the public list AND reverts the user's role. Unauth POST → 403, wrong passcode → 401.

Frontend (Playwright, mobile 390x844, live preview URL): (A) Psychologist login: +919999900001 / 123456 on /login (testIDs login-phone-input + otp-input + 'Send code' + 'Verify' buttons) routes to /psy-dashboard, shows 'Live · Dr. Ruchi Sharma' header, and lists the seeded awaiting_confirmation booking with testIDs psy-booking-{id}, accept-{id}, reschedule-{id}, decline-{id} — VISUAL PASS. (B) Admin dashboard on /admin (passcode Kanha@1983) reveals the Psychologists section with 'Add doctor' toggle (psy-add-toggle). Add form fields (psy-name, psy-phone, psy-specs, psy-price, psy-day-*, psy-save) all present and functional. Creating 'TEST Dr. UI Doctor' via psy-save adds a new psy-row-{id} card; clicking psy-del-{id} removes it — PASS. NOTE: /app/frontend/src/api.ts (line 67-74) was FIXED by this test agent — adminApi(token) previously only exposed .get and .put, so AdminPsychologists.tsx calls to .post and .del threw '(0, _srcApi.adminApi)(...).post is not a function' at runtime (screenshot /tmp/admin_form.png). Added .post and .del methods; retest confirmed the Add-doctor + Delete flows now work end-to-end from the UI. (C) Appointments screen (/appointments) renders the new status labels — 'Awaiting confirmation' pill visible on the seeded booking card in Playwright DOM, per code new statuses accepted → 'Confirmed', rescheduled → 'Rescheduled — review', declined → 'Declined', cancelled → 'Cancelled'. Bell icon has testID 'appt-bell'. (D) /notifications page loads via direct nav (testID notif-back present, title 'Notifications', 'You're all caught up.' for a freshly-read demo user).

ISSUE FOUND (report-only, not blocking Phase-1 acceptance because direct nav to /notifications works and REST refetch-on-focus is used): the Appointments bell (testID='appt-bell') does not appear to navigate to /notifications when tapped in the web preview — tested via .click(force=True) AND page.mouse.click at bbox center, URL stayed at /appointments, no popstate event fired. The direct /notifications URL renders correctly, so this is a bell-Pressable interaction issue on RN-Web only (may still work on Expo Go / native). Not reproducible via API. Recommend the main agent verify tap handler dispatch on the bell Pressable OR wrap the bell in a Link component from expo-router for web reliability.

ui_bugs.issue: FIXED IN /app/frontend/src/api.ts. Original adminApi(token) only exposed .get and .put, but /app/frontend/src/AdminPsychologists.tsx called .post (for creating doctors, line 45) and .del (for delete, line 67). This threw '(0, _srcApi.adminApi)(...).post is not a function' at runtime, blocking Add-doctor and Delete flows. Fix: added post and del methods to adminApi factory. Verified via UI: Add-doctor → doctor row appears; Delete → doctor row disappears.

Tapping <Pressable testID='appt-bell'> in /app/frontend/app/appointments.tsx:38 does not navigate to /notifications on the web preview (Playwright .click(force=True) and mouse.click at bbox center both keep URL at /appointments; no popstate; nav did not happen). Direct navigation to /notifications works and the page renders fine. Likely an RN-Web Pressable/onPress dispatch issue for this specific handler; may not affect native. Recommend wrapping in expo-router <Link href='/notifications' asChild> or ensuring the Pressable is not covered by an ancestor with pointerEvents='none'. Reference: /app/frontend/app/appointments.tsx:38

react_native_issues.issue: Cosmetic console warning on web preview only: 'shadow* style props are deprecated. Use boxShadow'. Non-blocking on native. Carried from prior iterations.
Cosmetic console warning on web preview only: 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents'. Non-blocking on native. Carried from prior iterations.

'[expo-notifications] Listening to push token changes is not yet fully supported on web' — informational; the push channel is intentionally expected to fail on web preview (audit reports channel='push' status='failure', which is verified by the pytest suite as EXPECTED per the review-request note). Real push requires a native build with EMERGENT_PUSH_KEY set.

action_items: MEDIUM: Fix bell-tap navigation in /app/frontend/app/appointments.tsx:38. Either (a) wrap the bell in expo-router <Link href='/notifications' asChild><Pressable testID='appt-bell'>…</Pressable></Link>, or (b) verify no ancestor pointer-events blocker in styles.header/headerRow. Direct nav to /notifications works, so the fix is purely on the tap-handler side.

OPTIONAL: Consider moving the adminApi helper additions committed by the test agent into a small typed AdminApi interface in /app/frontend/src/api.ts to avoid future drift when new admin endpoints are added.
OPTIONAL: RN-Web deprecation warnings (shadow*, props.pointerEvents) carried from prior iterations — cosmetic only.
critical_code_review_comments: /app/frontend/src/api.ts:67-74 was MISSING post + del on adminApi. Fixed by this test agent (added parity with the user-scoped api object). Root cause: partial refactor when admin CRUD was added — AdminPsychologists was written against the intended API surface but the helper was never updated. Suggest a TS interface + unit test to catch this class of mismatch.

/app/backend/routes/bookings.py atomic slot reservation via unique index on (psychologist_id, slot_id) + DuplicateKeyError → 409 is correct and race-safe. Idempotency short-circuit at lines 49-59 correctly returns the existing order (same booking_id) without re-hitting Razorpay.

/app/backend/routes/psy.py: role gating via get_psychologist (security.py:57) — verifies role=='psychologist' AND psychologist_id is set; returns 403 otherwise. Correct. Accept/decline/reschedule set status_history[] correctly and reschedule uses the same unique-index trick to prevent races when moving to the new slot.

/app/backend/services/notifications.py: audit rows are inserted for every channel attempt (in_app + push) with status='success' or 'failure'+error. Realtime (WS) attempts are logged only on failure, which is fine but not auditable — consider adding a 'realtime' audit row too for completeness (nice-to-have, not blocking).

/app/backend/routes/admin.py: create_psychologist links a psychologist user account via link_psychologist_user (services/psychologists.py:37) with upsert — idempotent; delete_psychologist calls unlink_psychologist_user which reverts role to 'user'. Confirmed working in both API test and UI test.

/app/frontend/app/psy-dashboard.tsx: WS reconnect + REST refetch-on-focus dual channel is a sound realtime fallback — matches the review-request note that WS may not work through the web preview proxy.

/app/frontend/app/appointments.tsx: The bell Pressable is inside a headerRow with justifyContent:'space-between' and a Display title as a sibling. On RN-Web the Display <Text> component may cover a portion of the touch target if styled with flex:1 or wide width. Recommend an explicit width or zIndex on the bell to guarantee tap dispatch on web.

success_rate.backend: 100% (16/16 pytest tests passed on live preview URL — slot 409, idempotency, role gating, accept/decline/reschedule + notification+audit, notifications inbox, admin psychologist CRUD, bad-passcode 401)
success_rate.frontend: ~90% — psychologist login → /psy-dashboard with Accept/Reschedule/Decline testIDs PASS; admin dashboard Add-doctor → Save → row appears → Delete → row gone PASS (after api.ts fix); appointments screen shows new status pills; direct nav to /notifications PASS. ONE regression on the appointments-bell → /notifications tap navigation (see frontend_issues).

seed_data_creation: Backend pytest creates and immediately deletes: 3 short-lived awaiting_confirmation bookings + slot_locks under demo user (+919999900000) for accept/decline/reschedule; 1 admin-created doctor +919888800077 (linked user + profile) deleted at test end. UI test also created + deleted a 'TEST Dr. UI Doctor' (+919888800088). One transient UI-test booking under slot_id starting 'SEED-UI-' was manually cleaned up at the end of the run. Demo user and Dr. Ruchi profile are unchanged.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend URL from EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL (=EXPO_BACKEND_URL) in /app/frontend/.env. Demo user +919999900000/123456; psychologist +919999900001/123456 (routes to /psy-dashboard); admin passcode Kanha@1983 (POST /api/admin/auth). To reproduce psy-dashboard content in the UI, seed an awaiting_confirmation booking directly via db.bookings + db.slot_locks (Razorpay signature cannot be produced by automation — this is explicit in the review-request note). See helper _seed_booking() in /app/backend/tests/test_phase1_realtime_booking.py. Push notifications are expected to appear as channel='push' status='failure' in db.notification_audit for every notify_user call — this is by design (placeholder EMERGENT_PUSH_KEY on the web preview). WebSocket realtime (/api/ws?token=) may not proxy through the preview cluster; REST refetch-on-focus is the covered fallback in psy-dashboard.tsx. The only outstanding UI bug is the /appointments bell tap not navigating to /notifications on RN-Web (see action_items). /app/frontend/src/api.ts adminApi factory was extended in this iteration to include post + del — future admin endpoints should hang off this factory.
rca_of_issue:
AdminPsychologists.post/del breakage RCA: When the admin doctor-CRUD feature was added in the backend refactor, the frontend consumer /app/frontend/src/AdminPsychologists.tsx was written against a full CRUD helper (get/post/put/del), but /app/frontend/src/api.ts adminApi(token) was only extended with .get and .put — the .post and .del methods were never added. TypeScript did not catch this because adminApi returned an inferred inline object with no explicit interface, so accessing .post at the call-site produced 'undefined' at runtime rather than a compile error. Reproduction: /admin → passcode Kanha@1983 → scroll to Psychologists → Add doctor → fill form → Save → runtime error '(0, _srcApi.adminApi)(...).post is not a function' rendered under the form (screenshot /tmp/admin_form.png). Fix applied in api.ts by adding parity post + del methods matching the user-scoped api object. Retest confirms end-to-end Add + Delete UI now works.

Appointments-bell RCA (report-only): The <Pressable testID='appt-bell' onPress={() => router.push('/notifications')}> at appointments.tsx:38 renders fine but the onPress does not dispatch when tapped in the web preview. Direct navigation to /notifications works, so the route + component are healthy — the issue is on the tap-handler side. Likely causes: (a) an ancestor View intercepts pointer events via a stretched layout (headerRow gap or the Display title's flex behaviour), (b) RN-Web quirk on force-click. Recommended fix by main agent: wrap the Pressable in expo-router <Link href='/notifications' asChild> so web falls back to a native <a> anchor with an href.
